name: SweepWidget – Contests, Giveaways, Sweepstakes & Photo Contests
author: sweepwidget

sections.description:
SweepWidget is the most powerful free WordPress giveaway plugin for creating viral contests, sweepstakes, photo contests, voting contests, raffles, leaderboard competitions, instant coupons, and more. With 130+ entry methods across 30+ social platforms (more than any other WordPress contest plugin), SweepWidget helps you grow your email list, increase social media followers, drive website traffic, and boost sales. Set up your first giveaway in minutes with the drag-and-drop builder. No coding required.

Why use SweepWidget?

  • Drag-and-drop giveaway builder – Create any type of contest in minutes. No coding or design skills needed. Mobile-responsive and optimized for speed on any device.
  • 130+ entry methods – More than any other WordPress giveaway plugin (most offer 20-30). More options means more engagement and more growth for your brand.
  • Grow your email list with 21+ CRM integrations – Collect unlimited emails and automatically sync new subscribers to Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, ConvertKit, and more. Every entrant becomes a lead.
  • WooCommerce integration – Connect your WooCommerce store and automatically reward customers with contest entries for every dollar they spend. Purchases are tracked in real-time with API verification. Turn your existing store traffic into giveaway participants and turn giveaway participants into paying customers.
  • 30+ social media integrations – Run Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Twitter / X, Pinterest, TikTok, Threads, Discord, Telegram, Twitch, Reddit, Spotify, and LinkedIn contests with API-verified entries wherever possible.
  • The strongest anti-fraud protection in the industry – Block bots, cheaters, and fake entries with VPN/proxy/Tor detection, behavioral bot analysis, disposable email filtering (4,940+ domains), device fingerprinting, and smart rate limiting. Every winner is legitimate, every email is real, and your brand reputation stays protected.
  • Photo contests, video contests, and voting – Let your audience upload content, vote on their favorites, and build excitement around your brand with a beautiful gallery display. Perfect for user-generated content campaigns.
  • Leaderboard competitions and instant rewards – Create real-time ranked competitions, deliver instant coupons and instant prizes automatically, and keep users coming back with milestone rewards.
  • 12 social login options – Facebook, Google, X, Discord, Twitch, Spotify, and more. Your users can enter in seconds.
  • Viral share and refer-a-friend contests – Each user gets a unique referral link to share. More referrals means more entries, which drives organic traffic back to your giveaway.
  • Shopify integration – Run purchase-based contests on your Shopify store with one-click embed and automatic order tracking.
  • 103 languages – Run international contests that feel native to every audience.
  • Embed anywhere – Add your giveaway to any WordPress page with a 1-line shortcode, embed on any website with JavaScript, or use a free hosted landing page.
  • Custom design & CSS – 900+ Google Fonts, full color control, custom CSS, and white-labeling to match your brand perfectly.
  • Zapier integration to connect with 5,000+ apps. Full REST API for developers.
  • Accept payments – Collect donations, sell products, and run fundraiser raffles directly from your giveaway.
  • Custom SMTP for white-label email delivery from your own domain.
  • Free plan with unlimited entries – Get started at no cost. Upgrade when you are ready.

Entry methods

SweepWidget supports 130+ entry methods across every major platform. Here are some of the most popular:

Instagram

  • Instagram giveaway to grow your Instagram page.
  • Instagram contest to get more Instagram followers, likes, comments, reposts, tags, and visits.

Facebook

  • Facebook giveaway to grow your Facebook page.
  • Facebook contest to get more Facebook likes, comments, shares, group joins, and visits.

TikTok

  • TikTok giveaway to grow your TikTok page.
  • TikTok contest to get more TikTok followers, liked videos, views, comments, shares, and visits.

YouTube

  • YouTube giveaway to grow your YouTube channel.
  • YouTube contest to get more YouTube subscribers, comments, likes, video views, and visits. API-verified entries.

Twitter / X

  • Twitter / X giveaway to grow your Twitter / X page.
  • Twitter / X contest to get more followers, tweets, retweets, and visits.

Threads

  • Threads contest to get more Threads followers, reposts, and comments.

Pinterest

  • Pinterest giveaway to grow your Pinterest page.
  • Pinterest contest to get more Pinterest followers, repins, board follows, and visitors. API-verified entries.

LinkedIn

  • LinkedIn giveaway to grow your LinkedIn profile.
  • LinkedIn contest to get more LinkedIn followers and shares. API-verified entries.

Discord

  • Discord contest to grow your Discord server. API-verified join confirmation.

Twitch

  • Twitch giveaway to grow your Twitch channel.
  • Twitch contest to get more Twitch followers and subscriptions. API-verified entries.

Telegram

  • Telegram giveaway to grow your Telegram channel or group.
  • Telegram contest to get more Telegram followers and comments. API-verified via bot webhook.

Reddit

  • Reddit giveaway to grow your Reddit community.
  • Reddit contest to get more subreddit subscribers and comments. API-verified entries.

Spotify

  • Spotify giveaway to grow your Spotify channel.
  • Spotify contest to get more Spotify followers, playlist follows, and song listens.

SoundCloud

  • SoundCloud giveaway to grow your SoundCloud page.
  • SoundCloud contest to get more SoundCloud followers, song likes, reposts, and listens.

Medium

  • Medium contest to get more claps and comments on your articles.

Other Platforms

  • Snapchat giveaway to grow your Snapchat profile and get more followers.
  • Tumblr giveaway to grow your Tumblr page and get more followers and liked posts.
  • Etsy giveaway to grow your Etsy shop, get more followers, likes, and sales.
  • eBay giveaway to grow your eBay shop and increase sales.
  • Steam giveaway to get more Steam group members.
  • Patreon giveaway to grow your Patreon page and get more donations.
  • Eventbrite giveaway to get more event attendees.
  • Bloglovin’ giveaway to increase your Bloglovin’ followers.

Custom & Miscellaneous Entry Methods

  • Visit a page giveaway to increase website traffic with a contest.
  • Subscribe to newsletter giveaway to increase your email leads and signups. We have 21+ CRM email provider API integrations.
  • RSS giveaway to grow your RSS followers.
  • Blog comment giveaway to increase blog comments on your website.
  • Disqus comment giveaway to get more Disqus comments.
  • Custom user fields giveaway to collect user data and increase leads, sales, and signups.
  • Create poll / survey giveaway to create custom quizzes, surveys, polls, and more.
  • App download giveaway to increase your app downloads.
  • Upload a file giveaway to get user photos, videos, and files.
  • Bonus giveaway to collect bonus entries.
  • Refer friends giveaway for viral sharing and refer-a-friend contests.
  • Create your own entry method giveaway to make any type of contest you want!
  • Enter a secret code to unlock bonus entries.
  • Leave a review to earn entries.
  • FeedBurner and FeedPress subscriptions.

Custom Form Fields

Collect exactly the data you need with custom form fields: text input, select dropdown, radio buttons, textarea, checkboxes, birthday, full name, address, phone number (with international country codes), and e-signature capture.

Crypto Wallet Entry Methods

Perfect for crypto giveaways and airdrops. Collect BTC, ETH / BEP-20, BEP-2, Solana, and other crypto wallet addresses.

E-Commerce Entry Methods

Turn your customers into contest entrants and drive repeat purchases:

  • WooCommerce purchase entries – Connect your WooCommerce store and customers automatically earn entries for every $1 they spend. Tracked in real-time with API verification. Choose specific products or apply to your entire store.
  • Shopify purchase entries – Same dollar-for-entry system for Shopify stores with API-verified order tracking.
  • Manual purchase verification for any other store platform.

Competition types

Run any type of promotion you can think of:

  • Sweepstakes / Giveaway – Pick random winners from your entrants. Users with more entries have a higher chance of winning.
  • Photo / Video Contest with Voting – Let users upload photos or videos and have your audience vote on their favorites. Includes a beautiful voting gallery with thumbnails, vote counts, and admin moderation. Great as a standalone voting contest or as part of a larger giveaway.
  • Leaderboard Competition – Show real-time rankings so your audience can see who is in the lead. Display up to 500 users with flexible name privacy options.
  • Instant Win / Instant Prizes – Reward users with prizes the moment they hit an entry threshold. Instant gratification keeps them engaged.
  • Instant Coupon Distribution – Automatically deliver unique coupon codes when users reach milestones. Perfect for driving sales from your giveaway traffic.
  • Milestone Rewards – Set entry milestones that unlock rewards as users earn more entries. Progress tracking keeps them motivated to keep going.

Winner selection

Picking winners is simple and flexible:

  • Randomly generate winners – Pick any number of winners with one click. Filter by entry count and let the system weight results by entries earned.
  • Manually pick winners – Hand-pick winners yourself and allocate specific prizes to each one.
  • Live Draw – Announce winners with a full-screen reveal perfect for live streams and events. Includes confetti animation, prize display, and a “Pick Another Winner” button.
  • Redemption codes – Assign unique redemption codes to prizes. Each winner gets their own claim page with built-in double-redemption protection.
  • Winner emails – Send personalized winner notification emails with merge tags like [FIRST_NAME], [LAST_NAME], and [REDEMPTION_CODE_CLAIM_LINK].

Email marketing integrations

Automatically sync your giveaway entrants to your favorite email marketing platform. We support 21+ integrations:

  • Mailchimp
  • AWeber
  • ActiveCampaign
  • Constant Contact
  • ConvertKit
  • MailerLite
  • SendFox
  • Campaign Monitor
  • GetResponse
  • Drip
  • Klaviyo
  • Iterable
  • SendGrid
  • Pabbly
  • HubSpot
  • Sendy
  • EmailOctopus
  • Omnisend
  • MailJet
  • Mad Mimi
  • Braze

Social login

Make it easy for users to enter by letting them log in with any of 12 social accounts: Facebook, X (Twitter), Google, LinkedIn, Twitch, Discord, Steam, Tumblr, Telegram, Reddit, Pinterest, and Spotify. One click and they are in.

Design & customization

Make your giveaway match your brand perfectly:

  • Full color customization – Customize every color in your widget including container, body, title, buttons, inputs, links, and landing page background.
  • 900+ Google Fonts plus system fonts with configurable sizes for body, title, buttons, and more.
  • Flexible layout options – Set your widget width anywhere from 300px to 1,200px, choose left/center/right alignment, and toggle border shadows.
  • 8 image display formats – Full width, small left/right/above/below, medium above/below, or custom dimensions for your prize images.
  • YouTube video embed as your featured media.
  • Custom logo upload with an optional clickable link.
  • Custom CSS editor with syntax highlighting for complete control over every detail of your widget appearance.
  • Widget popup / modal mode – Turn any embedded widget into a popup that appears after a delay. Great for lead capture and exit-intent promotions.
  • 2,000+ custom entry icons to make your entry methods stand out.
  • Custom icon colors to match your brand.
  • Remove branding for a fully white-labeled experience.
  • Toggle visibility of the giveaway title, description, separator lines, “My Entries” count, or “Total Entries” count.
  • Choose between circle or square icon styles.

Landing pages & embedding

Get your giveaway in front of your audience however you want:

  • Free hosted landing pages on sweepwidget.com/c/your-giveaway with automatic Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags for beautiful social sharing.
  • Custom URL slugs – Use your own branded URL path for a professional look.
  • QR code generation – Download a crisp SVG QR code linking to your giveaway. Perfect for print materials, event signage, and packaging.
  • WordPress shortcode – Embed with a single line: [sweepwidget id=”123″ url=”your-giveaway”].
  • JavaScript embed – Add your giveaway to any website with a simple div and script tag.
  • Shopify quick-embed – Create a giveaway page in your Shopify store with one click.
  • Pre-fill & auto-login – Pre-fill email and name from email campaigns so returning users can enter instantly.
  • Giveaway directory – Your giveaway can appear in the public directory at sweepwidget.com/enter-giveaways for extra exposure.

Security & anti-fraud

Run your giveaways with total confidence. SweepWidget has the most advanced anti-fraud system of any contest plugin, with multiple layers of protection working together to keep your results clean and your winners legitimate. Your audience trusts your brand, and SweepWidget helps you keep it that way.

  • 4 security levels – Weak, Standard, Strong, and Strict with escalating device fingerprinting. Choose the right balance for your campaign.
  • VPN & proxy detection – 3 independent detection services (IPQS Device Fingerprint, IPQS IP API, ProxyCheck.io) block VPN, proxy, and Tor users from entering with fake identities.
  • Behavioral anti-bot detection – Detects automated tools like Selenium, Playwright, and Puppeteer. Analyzes keyboard timing, mouse behavior, and form submission speed to catch bots that bypass traditional defenses.
  • Disposable email blocking – 4,940+ blocked throwaway email domains plus intelligent email quality scoring that catches suspicious patterns (random strings, high-digit usernames, known spam TLDs).
  • IP protections – Duplicate IP blocking, configurable max emails per IP, global IP blacklist/whitelist, and per-competition IP lists.
  • Rate limiting – Per-competition and global rate limits with automatic temporary IP bans after repeated abuse attempts.
  • Country restrictions – Geo-location filtering by country with CloudFlare detection.
  • Age verification – Minimum or maximum age requirement (1-99 years) with date format options.
  • Email verification (2FA) – 4-digit verification code sent via email to confirm real email addresses.
  • SMS verification – Via Twilio integration with international phone support (Enterprise).
  • Max people / entries limits – Cap total entrants or total entries.
  • Honeypot fields – Hidden fields that catch bots without affecting real users.
  • Require Google reCAPTCHA.
  • Whitelisted emails only – Restrict entry to a pre-approved email list for private or invite-only giveaways.
  • Referral fraud prevention – Self-referral detection and velocity limits to prevent gaming the referral system.
  • Cross-competition fraud detection – Tracks abuse patterns across multiple giveaways to catch repeat offenders.

Analytics & tracking

See exactly how your giveaway is performing:

  • Built-in analytics dashboard – Track total views, unique views, users entered, actions, entries, and conversion rate. Includes daily trend charts, entry method performance breakdown, device distribution, geography (top 10 countries), conversion funnel, and top referrer domains.
  • Export analytics to CSV, JSON, or Text.
  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4) – Automatically track giveaway events like page views, logins, entries, and contest completions.
  • Google Tag Manager – Full DataLayer integration for custom tracking and remarketing.
  • Facebook / Meta Pixel – Track PageView, ViewContent, Lead, and CompleteRegistration events for retargeting.
  • TikTok Pixel – Track PageView, ViewContent, SubmitForm, and CompleteRegistration events.

Referral & viral sharing

Turn every entrant into a brand ambassador. Each user gets a unique referral link they can share to earn bonus entries, which drives organic traffic back to your giveaway.

  • Unique referral URL per user for viral sharing.
  • Share via Facebook, Twitter / X, LinkedIn, Email, WhatsApp, SMS, and Copy Link.
  • **Bonus entries for …
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sweepwidget folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the SweepWidget plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. You will now have an additional “SweepWidget Contests” menu item in the admin dashboard. You can manage and add new giveaways here.
sections.faq:
What entry methods are available?

Over 130+ entry methods across 30+ social media integrations, making SweepWidget the most comprehensive WordPress giveaway plugin available. See features in the description above for the full list.

What does a promotion look like?

You can see examples for every type of giveaway here: Live Examples

Do you offer unlimited entries?

Yes! All plans include unlimited user entries.

Can I collect email addresses?

Yes! Collect unlimited emails and export to CSV. Connect to 21+ email marketing platforms including Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, HubSpot, ConvertKit, and more.

Can I run photo or video contests?

Yes! Users can upload photos or videos, and winners can be chosen by public voting or admin judging. Includes a gallery display, vote counts, and submission moderation.

How do I add a competition to my WordPress site?

Just paste a simple 1-line shortcode into any post or page. The giveaway widget loads instantly and is fully responsive. Here’s a detailed article on how it integrates with WordPress.

How much does SweepWidget cost?

SweepWidget has a free plan to get started, plus Pro ($29/mo), Business ($59/mo), Premium ($119/mo), and Enterprise ($249/mo) plans. Annual plans save up to 2 months. All plans include unlimited user entries. You can see the breakdown of which features come with each plan.

What payment methods do you offer?

We accept all major credit cards and PayPal.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes! We offer both monthly and annual plans. You can cancel anytime you want and won’t be charged again.

What data will I receive for each entrant?

You will receive: full name, email address, phone number, date of birth, entry type, action, entry details, entries worth, time of entry, country, URL referral parameters, and all custom field responses.

What integrations does SweepWidget have?

SweepWidget integrates with Zapier, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter / X, Threads, Pinterest, YouTube, TikTok, Discord, Twitch, Telegram, Reddit, Spotify, LinkedIn, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Facebook / Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce, Mailchimp, AWeber, ActiveCampaign, Constant Contact, ConvertKit, MailerLite, SendFox, Campaign Monitor, GetResponse, Drip, Klaviyo, Iterable, SendGrid, Pabbly, HubSpot, Sendy, EmailOctopus, Omnisend, MailJet, Braze, and more.

Does SweepWidget offer leaderboard contests?

Yes! Here’s an example leaderboard giveaway. Leaderboard contests show real-time rankings and are a great way to incentivize users to share and engage more.

Does SweepWidget offer instant coupons?

Yes! Here’s an example instant coupons giveaway. Deliver unique coupon codes automatically when users reach entry milestones.

Does SweepWidget offer unlock rewards?

Yes! Here’s an example unlock rewards giveaway. Users unlock prizes, coupons, and rewards as they earn more entries.

Does SweepWidget have anti-fraud protection?

Yes, and it is the most comprehensive anti-fraud system of any contest plugin. SweepWidget protects your giveaway with multi-layered security: 4 configurable security levels, VPN/proxy/Tor detection (3 independent services), disposable email blocking (4,940+ domains), behavioral bot detection (catches Selenium, Playwright, Puppeteer), device fingerprinting, keyboard timing analysis, rate limiting, IP blacklists/whitelists, Google reCAPTCHA, honeypot fields, and cross-competition fraud detection. Every entry is verified so your results are trustworthy and your brand stays protected.

Can I use SweepWidget with WooCommerce?

Yes! Connect your WooCommerce store and your customers will automatically earn contest entries for every dollar they spend. Purchases are tracked in real-time with API verification, and you can choose specific products or apply it to your entire store. SweepWidget also has a dedicated Shopify app with the same purchase-based entry system.

Do you support different languages?

Yes! You can choose from 103 different languages to easily run an international contest. You can also manually edit every single word on the widget. The following languages are supported: Afrikaans, Albanian, Amharic, Arabic, Armenian, Azerbaijani, Basque, Belarusian, Bengali, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Catalan, Cebuano, Chinese, Corsican, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Esperanto, Estonian, Finnish, French, Frisian, Galician, Georgian, German, Greek, Gujarati, Haitian, Hausa, Hawaiian, Hebrew, Hindi, Hmong, Hungarian, Icelandic, Igbo, Indonesian, Irish, Italian, Japanese, Javanese, Kannada, Kazakh, Khmer, Korean, Kurdish, Kyrgyz, Lao, Latin, Latvian, Lithuanian, Luxembourgish, Macedonian, Malagasy, Malay, Malayalam, Maltese, Maori, Marathi, Mongolian, Myanmar, Nepali, Norwegian, Nyanja, Pashto, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Punjabi, Romanian, Russian, Samoan, Scots, Serbian, Sesotho, Shona, Sindhi, Sinhala, Slovak, Slovenian, Somali, Spanish, Sundanese, Swahili, Swedish, Tagalog, Tajik, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese, Welsh, Xhosa, Yiddish, Yoruba, Zulu.

Can I allow daily entries?

Yes! You can choose any interval from 1 entry per hour up to every 24 hours (or at midnight). View here.

Can I require mandatory entries?

Yes! You can make it so users aren’t allowed to perform certain actions until they complete other actions. View here. You can also daisy-chain entries to require sequential completion.

Does SweepWidget have a Live Draw feature?

Yes! The Live Draw feature provides a full-screen winner announcement interface perfect for live streams and events, complete with confetti animation and prize display.

Does SweepWidget have an official rules generator?

Yes! SweepWidget includes a built-in legal rules template generator with 15 sections covering eligibility, prizes, winner selection, terms, and social media disclaimers.

Can I invite team members?

Yes! Invite team members with role-based permissions (Administrator, Collaborator, Read-only). Up to 5 team members on Enterprise plans.

Can I display a giveaway as a popup?

Yes! You can convert any embedded giveaway into a popup/modal that appears after a configurable delay timer. Great for exit-intent promotions and lead capture.

Can I generate a QR code for my giveaway?

Yes! SweepWidget automatically generates a downloadable SVG QR code that links to your giveaway’s hosted landing page. Perfect for print materials, event signage, and product packaging.

Is SweepWidget GDPR compliant?

Yes! SweepWidget supports full account and data deletion for both contest organizers and entrants. Entrants can manage their own personal data through a verification-protected account page.

Can I pre-fill user information from an email campaign?

Yes! You can pre-fill email and name fields via URL parameters and even auto-login returning users. This creates a seamless entry experience when sending traffic from email campaigns or CRM workflows.

Additional information

Please review our detailed documentation for additional instructions. Please access our terms of use for any legal questions.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Added functionality to be able to create and manage SweepWidget giveaways directly from your WordPress account. Seamless login process and account creation. Add custom shortcodes directly into WordPress posts and pages.

1.0.2

  • Added submenu items for easier navigation. Also, added minor UI improvements

1.0.3

  • More improvements to navigation and UI. More easily manage your SweepWidget account from your WordPress portal.

1.0.4

  • Improve workflow of accepting payments.

2.0

  • Removed the iframe. You can now manage your SweepWidget account natively in your WordPress account without an iframe wrapper. This will work even with third-party cookies disabled.

2.0.1

  • Copy WordPress shortcode from main dashboard.

2.0.2

  • New navigation, cleaner styling, easier to navigate and manage giveaways.

2.0.3

  • More seamless plugin installation.

2.0.4

  • Fixed a bug on the main page.

2.0.5

  • Redirect user to plugin on activation. Update URL path for SweepWidget plugin.

2.0.6

  • Added some bug fixes to work in all browsers.

2.0.7

  • Security fix: Sanitized and escaped shortcode attributes to prevent stored XSS.
  • Security fix: Escaped all output throughout the plugin using esc_html(), esc_attr(), and esc_url().
  • Replaced raw cURL with WordPress HTTP API (wp_remote_get).
  • Removed bundled jQuery – now uses WordPress built-in jQuery.
  • Added direct file access protection.
  • Moved admin scripts to properly enqueued file with jQuery dependency.
  • Prefixed all functions to prevent naming conflicts.
  • Added error handling for API responses.
  • Modernized admin dashboard design.

Security & anti-fraud

Run your giveaways with total confidence. SweepWidget has the most advanced anti-fraud system of any contest plugin, with multiple layers of protection working together to keep your results clean and your winners legitimate. Your audience trusts your brand, and SweepWidget helps you keep it that way.

  • 4 security levels – Weak, Standard, Strong, and Strict with escalating device fingerprinting. Choose the right balance for your campaign.
  • VPN & proxy detection – 3 independent detection services (IPQS Device Fingerprint, IPQS IP API, ProxyCheck.io) block VPN, proxy, and Tor users from entering with fake identities.
  • Behavioral anti-bot detection – Detects automated tools like Selenium, Playwright, and Puppeteer. Analyzes keyboard timing, mouse behavior, and form submission speed to catch bots that bypass traditional defenses.
  • Disposable email blocking – 4,940+ blocked throwaway email domains plus intelligent email quality scoring that catches suspicious patterns (random strings, high-digit usernames, known spam TLDs).
  • IP protections – Duplicate IP blocking, configurable max emails per IP, global IP blacklist/whitelist, and per-competition IP lists.
  • Rate limiting – Per-competition and global rate limits with automatic temporary IP bans after repeated abuse attempts.
  • Country restrictions – Geo-location filtering by country with CloudFlare detection.
  • Age verification – Minimum or maximum age requirement (1-99 years) with date format options.
  • Email verification (2FA) – 4-digit verification code sent via email to confirm real email addresses.
  • SMS verification – Via Twilio integration with international phone support (Enterprise).
  • Max people / entries limits – Cap total entrants or total entries.
  • Honeypot fields – Hidden fields that catch bots without affecting real users.
  • Require Google reCAPTCHA.
  • Whitelisted emails only – Restrict entry to a pre-approved email list for private or invite-only giveaways.
  • Referral fraud prevention – Self-referral detection and velocity limits to prevent gaming the referral system.
  • Cross-competition fraud detection – Tracks abuse patterns across multiple giveaways to catch repeat offenders.
